title: Accordion from <details> that unfolds
blurb: Four <details name> elements drawn by a canvas. The closed and open pictures of each one are joined by a paper fold: the content is drawn as sheared strips, from a snapshot when closing and from the live element when opening.
question: A <details> element has two pictures, closed and open, and the browser switches between them in one step. Can a canvas hold both and animate between them?
result: Yes. A snapshot taken while the element is open gives the open picture after it has closed. The content of a closed element can't be drawn any other way.
